title: Migration Wave Orchestration, Throttling Management & Post-Migration Validation
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Run migration cutovers on rails — waved, throttled, and validated
problem: A migration plan isn't a migration execution. This solution is the tool-agnostic cutover operations layer that sits over whatever engine you use: batch users into waves, manage throttling and API limits (Microsoft & Google), sequence pre-stage → delta → cutover, run post-migration validation (item counts, permissions, mail flow, delegates), and drive hypercare issue triage — so cutovers finish clean with evidence, not surprises.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the cutover-ops model: wave batching, throttling/API-limit management, pre-stage/delta/cutover sequencing, validation, and hypercare — tool-agnostic.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (a chosen migration engine, M365 + Google admin access, user/wave data, validation criteria, hypercare team).
Implementation Guide — build wave batches, set throttling/limit strategy, sequence pre-stage/delta/cutover, run post-migration validation, and operate hypercare triage — pilot-first, each wave named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (waves cut over clean, validation passes, issues triaged within SLA) plus Best Practices for throttling and cutover sequencing.
short: Run migration cutover operations tool-agnostically — wave batching, throttling/API-limit management, pre-stage/delta/cutover sequencing, post-migration validation, and hypercare triage — so cutovers finish clean with evidence. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
